originality.rationale: Takahashi–Iwao (2007), Sections 4–5, establishes the invariant curves, their vertices, the rigid return rotation and rational orbit periods; none of that is claimed new. The present claim instead determines the physical-iterate rotation as an area-action function and, crucially, the complete pushforward of uniform planar area, its fixed-frequency atom and a Pareto-two large-cutoff law. The inspected 10-page primary text does not calculate these measures or limiting laws; exact-parameter searches, mathematical-research records and another relevant full manuscript did not reveal the same result. An equivalent unstated treatment under action-angle or tropical notation remains possible.
